description: List the questions tracked for a domain (the prompts Rankwise asks AI engines), each with its id, market locale, and its latest result across the engines that ask it: cited (at least one engine's latest answer links the brand), not_cited (engines answered and none links it), unconfirmed (an engine answered but nothing could be measured, see unmeasured_kind: hidden_sources = Google hid its source links, no_answer = no AI answer was shown), or error (the checks failed). Also the citation position and when that result was measured. A failed check on one engine never hides another engine's result.

domain_id.description: The tracked domain's id, from list_domains.

name: list_questions
title: List tracked questions
